symptom: A delayed DNS-SD callback terminates the process after discovery was reported as failed.
cause: Deckle treated DNS_REQUEST_PENDING as failure, released a live callback context, and later received the native callback.
violatedInvariant: Native request, cancellation state, and callback context remain valid until the terminal callback.

must: Treat DNS_REQUEST_PENDING as a successfully started asynchronous operation.
Ignore a late callback whose context is no longer registered.
mustNot: Release an active DNS-SD callback context after a successful start.

covered: late callback containment after context release
automation.residual: Native cancellation and terminal-callback ordering remain a Windows system test.
